results.title: Canada whips U.S. 8-1 to win Hlinka Gretzky Cup
results.description: EDMONTON — Brock England, Maddox Schultz and Liam Pue each scored twice, the power play went 3-for-5, and Canada whipped the United States 7-1 to win the Hlinka Gretzky Cup on Saturday.
